article.title: Sokoto rep's defection letter read at plenary
article.text: The Speaker, during Tuesday's plenary, read a letter from Hon. Garba Lawal Mairuwa of Sokoto Demo Constituency 1 notifying the House of his defection from the All Progressives Congress to the Peoples Democratic Party. Mairuwa said the division within the APC in Sokoto made his continued stay untenable.
